set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: F01
Accountable role (person not assigned): Backend lead with product owner

Outcome: A small organizational model with explicit authority and a migration path from the existing curator model.

Acceptance:
- Write an ADR and role/action matrix covering lab membership, project participation, dataset placement, discovery, source evidence, fixed-release sharing, grant expiry, principal disablement and stewardship transfer.
- Define link-versus-authority behavior, independent versus membership-derived grants and last-steward recovery without rewriting scientific identities.
- Specify public API and migration examples for existing datasets/curators; keep proposals clear where institution-specific inputs are outstanding.

Evidence anchors:
- docs/vision.md
- modules/kernel/src/main/scala/sanctity/kernel/Authority.scala
- modules/kernel/src/main/scala/sanctity/kernel/Lifecycle.scala

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: F01: Specify lab, project, role and offboarding contracts
